name: abi_peek_input
title: ABI: peek of an input never ticks and never clears dirty
description: After poke clk=1, two input peeks must return the poked value without advancing the circuit; the dirty flag must survive them, so the first output peek afterwards still ticks exactly once (out=1, not 3 or more).
